description: PTO accrual projection — Offline paid-time-off accrual projector. Give rate= hours accrued per pay period (or annual= hours per year) and period= weekly|biweekly|semimonthly|monthly. Projects balance per pay date with an accrual cap, planned time off (used=date:hours,...), the date the cap is hit and hours that would be lost, days remaining and payout value at hourly=. Notes state no-forfeiture rules (CA, MT, NE, CO). Params: rate or annual, period, balance, cap, start, periods, used, hourly, hoursPerDay, state. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: finance_pto_accrual
